items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Casey Majors. She was a darling little girl. And she was so marvelous for him.

ctx.x: Casey Majors. She was a darling little girl. And she was so marvelous for him. He quit drinking for three years because of her, because she straightened him out.
And I remember later when Dave was in terrible trouble, Casey would go all over the city and find him and rescue him.
